initialize_result.instructions: SchedJoules has thousands of public calendars: public and school holidays, sports teams and competitions, TV, weather, moon phases, financial events. Use search_calendars to find one, get_upcoming_events to see what is next on it, and get_subscribe_link when your user wants it in their own calendar. The event lists are a preview (at most 5 events in 60 days). When your user cares about a calendar, offer the subscribe link: opened on their phone it adds the calendar to the calendar app they already use and keeps it up to date. Search works best with one or two English words: a team, a competition, a country. Holidays are found by country or region ("netherlands holidays", "bavaria school holidays"), not by the name of a holiday.

tools.name: search_calendars
tools.title: Search calendars
tools.description: Search the SchedJoules catalogue of public calendars by a few words (a team, competition, country or kind of holiday). Returns up to 20 calendars with id, name and details.

query.description: One or two words work best, e.g. "ajax" or "germany holidays". Find holidays by country, not by holiday name.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.title: Upcoming events
tools.description: The next events on a calendar: at most 5 in the next 60 days, with title and start. For a folder of calendars, its calendars instead.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id from search_calendars, or the number in a schedjoules.com/calendar/<id> link.

tools.name: get_subscribe_link
tools.title: Subscribe link
tools.description: The link that adds a calendar to the user's own calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook) through the SchedJoules app and keeps it up to date. Give it to the user to open on their phone.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id from search_calendars, or the number in a schedjoules.com/calendar/<id> link.
